title: Elfs, transducers and quantum walks
summary: Electric flow sampling (elfs) is a new tool in the quantum walk toolbox and a useful primitive for solving search, sampling and optimization problems on graphs. We refine this tool by showing that there exists a zero-error transducer for implementing elfs. More broadly, we establish a zero-error transducer for reflecting about the intersection of two subspaces, yielding an errorfree transducer version of the effective gap lemma.
